text:
In losing you, you and I have lost:
        I, because you were what I loved most,
        and you, because I was the one who loved you most.


        But of the two of us, you lose more than I do:
        because I will be able to love others as I loved you,
        but you will not be loved as I loved you.

translation.title: Epigram
translation.editorial_note: This source preserves the indented epigram form while matching the already translated argument about unequal loss.
